req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /tasks/{task_id} persists changes so a subsequent GET reflects the update. I design: (1) a positive EP/STC test that creates a task, PUTs all mutable fields, then GETs and asserts exact values match; (2) a negative NEG test that PUTs to a non-existent task_id and asserts exactly HTTP 404 with the correct detail message; (3) a BVA boundary test that updates only the title field with a 1-character string (min_length boundary) and verifies persistence; (4) a DT test covering partial update (only `completed` toggled) to verify other fields are unchanged; (5) a BVA test with a 100-character title (max_length boundary) to catch off-by-one mutations on the field length constant. Each test uses an in-process TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory DB via dependency override to ensure isolation and determinism.

tests.name: test_put_persists_all_fields_positive
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Original', description='Orig desc', completed=false
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with title='Updated', description='New desc', completed=true
expected: PUT response body has title='Updated', description='New desc', completed=true
GET response body has title='Updated', description='New desc', completed=true
trace: R-TASK-022: PUT changes must be reflected in subsequent GET
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_persists_all_fields_positive():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original", "description": "Orig desc", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    r_put = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated", "description": "New desc", "completed": True})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    put_body = r_put.json()
    assert put_body["id"] == task_id
    assert put_body["title"] == "Updated"
    assert put_body["description"] == "New desc"
    assert put_body["completed"] is True
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    get_body = r_get.json()
    assert get_body["id"] == task_id
    assert get_body["title"] == "Updated"
    assert get_body["description"] == "New desc"
    assert get_body["completed"] is True

test_put_persists_all_fields_positive()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_completed_false_to_true_state_transition():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "State Task", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    assert r_create.json()["completed"] is False
    r_put1 = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": True})
    assert r_put1.status_code == 200
    assert r_put1.json()["completed"] is True
    r_get1 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get1.status_code == 200
    assert r_get1.json()["completed"] is True
    r_put2 = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": False})
    assert r_put2.status_code == 200
    assert r_put2.json()["completed"] is False
    r_get2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get2.status_code == 200
    assert r_get2.json()["completed"] is False

test_put_completed_false_to_true_state_transition()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
